creator: Alexander Terp
description: The remote install links the Linux muster CLI at ~/.muster/bin/muster, but the daemon's environment for a far pane (muster-daemon-client environment.rs for_far_daemon) adds nothing to PATH, so an agent on a devenv must spell ~/.muster/bin/muster or have it on its own PATH. Locally the daemon puts ~/.muster/bin first.
title: A remote pane's PATH lacks ~/.muster/bin
